text:
ashley: Quick flag: discovered a stale-read window when snapshot loads race with soft-evict. sketch below.

olivia: outline the sequence.

ashley: W commits to store -> node A soft-evicts prefix -> snapshot S produced (doesn't include W) -> node B claims and loads S -> client reads pre-W.

raj: so snapshot freshness isn't strong enough compared to demote. we need a durable coordination signal.

maria: idea: per-prefix "evict_fence" counter written on demote. snapshot manifest carries fence_seen. claimant compares fence_seen vs current fence and rejects old snapshots.

olivia: rejection path should try delta-apply first (small log) then full rebuild. avoid full rebuild if possible.

ashley: implementation notes: fence key at /evict-fence/<prefix>, increment on demote. snapshotter reads fence when creating snapshot. loader refuses if fence_seen < current.

raj: need pre-claim recheck to avoid race where demote happens between snapshot read and claim. claim path: read fence, try claim, re-read fence; if increased abort and retry.

maria: GC: remove fence key when prefix tombstones+manifest mark retired. add GC job TTL.

ci-bot: perf: 500 cycles, snapshot rejects 0.6%, median delta apply 2.4ms. report: https://ci/reports/9777-evictfence

olivia: good enough to prototype. ashley please write a short RFC with schema, compat rules (missing fence -> 0), and chaos tests.

ashley: will do. thanks.
